channel.title: JT Debrief
channel.description: A plain-language breakdown of Bedford Town FC's next opponent, built from scouting data Steve uploads plus supplementary research -- for the coaching staff, triggered on demand rather than on a schedule.
channel.itunes:author: JT Debrief

item.title: Ep 2 — Chester FC, away at Swansway Stadium
item.description: A Wyscout breakdown of Chester FC's last five league games ahead of Bedford Town's trip there on the tenth of October: a big gap between their underlying numbers and their results, Ben Waters as the clear attacking focus, and a repeated frailty down their right-back channel. Plus confirmed table position, fixture detail, and management context.

item.title: Ep 1 — Away at Spalding United
item.description: Bedford Town go to Spalding on the back of three straight wins, with a fresh Law change on delayed restarts now in effect and Real Bedford setting the pace two divisions down. Team news, the wider National League North picture, and what's moving at Step One and Step Three.
